purpose: Phase 0 reference for independent cold/control-plane XS reduction experiments

execution.host_load: No deliberate competing workload; CPU affinity and power controls unavailable in this environment

performance_regression_effective_stream_.transport: plain AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM socketpair for Stream lifecycle/throughput; IPv4 TCP loopback for connect/listener lifecycle
performance_regression_effective_stream_.framed_wire: Delimiter newline, excluded from delivered payload
performance_regression_effective_stream_.socket_options: OS defaults except abortive SO_LINGER on lifecycle clients
performance_regression_effective_stream_.throughput_pattern: 100 concurrent serial request/reply clients; one Perl callback per raw read or framed message

payload_sweep_effective_configuration: Recorded separately for raw and delimiter modes in stream-payload-sweep.json, including Stream tuning, framer parameters, transport, batching, buffer limits, socket buffers/options, topology, concurrency, producer batches, read/write/callback counts, CPU, and input peaks.

latency.performance_regression: Serial request/reply wall rate is retained; per-message percentile samples are not collected by contract version 3
latency.payload_sweep: Not sampled because this is a saturated one-way throughput baseline

comparison_policy.release_suite: Use the built-in paired configuration check and 10 percent regression threshold; inspect rotated raw samples before deciding
comparison_policy.payload_sweep: Run baseline and candidate on the same host/build configuration and compare medians at all nine sizes; interpret read/write splitting and CPU per byte alongside wall throughput
comparison_policy.baseline_reuse: Rebuild or retest this baseline when the benchmark contract, compiler/runtime, host, or branch foundation changes
